hw_classes.//: fit/needs_leaf are INTRINSIC (scalar stack-CPU design point), independent of support. needs_leaf names the datapath unit KIND required; current_module is the existing RTL instance or null if not built yet.

IMM.why: value materialized from oparg at decode

FRAME.why: call/return needs frame alloc + spill (intrinsically heavy on any target)

OBJECT.why: needs runtime objects/dicts/iterators; cannot map to a scalar tagged-value datapath

INTERNAL.why: interpreter plumbing (INSTRUMENTED_*, CACHE, RESERVED, EXTENDED_ARG, ENTER_EXECUTOR, INTERPRETER_EXIT, JUMP/JUMP_NO_INTERRUPT pseudo, ANNOTATIONS_PLACEHOLDER); never reaches a hardware target -> strip, not a gap

obj_groups.//: Sub-axis of hw_class=OBJECT only (all fit=infeasible, suppressed). needs_subsystem = runtime subsystem required; distance = how far beyond the scalar design point (D1 nearest .. D5 = whole runtime). Members partition the 88 OBJECT opcodes exactly (CALL is FRAME, not OBJECT). Powers the --include-out-of-scope expansion roadmap; does NOT affect default findings/backlog.

OBJ_SEQ.also_via_oparg: BINARY_OP[NB_SUBSCR=26] is the subscript READ (x[i]); BINARY_OP[NB_MATRIX_MULTIPLY=4/17] is @; both routed here from BINARY_OP.obj_group_by_arg, not standalone opcodes in 3.14

OBJ_CLOSURE.needs_subsystem: heap cell boxes for free vars

OBJ_EXC.note: v1 execute/partial: RAISE_VARARGS (oparg 0/1) / PUSH_EXC_INFO / CHECK_EXC_MATCH (identity+MRO+tuples) / POP_EXCEPT / RERAISE (0/1) + dmem exc stack + co_exceptiontable. Remaining members are trap. Types: exceptions.types + pycore/docs/exception_support.md. SETUP_* / POP_BLOCK are compiler pseudo-ops (never in co_code). Plan tracks in planning/exceptions_full_support_plan.md.

OBJ_CALL.needs_subsystem: full call/object-construction protocol (variadic + func-object creation; CALL/CALL_KW/CALL_FUNCTION_EX are FRAME, in-scope)

exceptions.//: Built-in exception types. Human table: pycore/docs/exception_support.md. Hierarchy: https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html. seed_track is which plan track inserts the type; uses_tracks consume it.

construct_levels.call: CALL on the type allocs OBK_EXCEPTION (Track 2)

BINARY_OP.note: 3.14 routes subscript and matmul THROUGH BINARY_OP: oparg 26 (NB_SUBSCR, x[i]) and 4/17 (NB_MATRIX_MULTIPLY @) resolve to hw_class OBJECT (suppressed, not a missing-ALU gap); opargs in class_by_arg.ALUN -> ALUN; all other supported opargs -> ALU1.

COMPARE_OP.note: Numeric + same-tag SHORT_STR/LONG_STR ==/!=; SHORT_STR lexicographic ordering; LONG_STR uses descriptor equality; LONG_STR ordering TYPE-traps

FORMAT_SIMPLE.note: value.__format__(""); STR identity; INT/BOOL/None → SHORT_STR decimal/literal (INT ≤15 chars); else TYPE

CONVERT_VALUE.note: 1=str 2=repr 3=ascii; INT/BOOL/None share str formatting; SHORT_STR !r/!a quote-wrap when ≤13 payload bytes; LONG_STR only oparg 1

BUILD_STRING.note: Concat oparg SHORT_STR pieces when total ≤15 bytes; LONG_STR pieces or overflow → TYPE

RAISE_VARARGS.note: oparg=0 reuses active_exc_r (no active exception is fatal until a RuntimeError sidecar exists); oparg=1 accepts an exception type or OBK_EXCEPTION instance; both walk co_exceptiontable and redirect or PY_TRAP_RAISE; see exception_support.md
RAISE_VARARGS.message: oparg 0/1: reuse active exception for bare raise or allocate/reuse TOS exception, then walk co_exceptiontable; oparg 2 raise-from remains unsupported

PUSH_EXC_INFO.note: dmem exc-info push + stack [prev, exc]; sets active_exc_r

CHECK_EXC_MATCH.note: identity then tp_base walk (depth 8) + one-level except (A,B) tuples cap 8; nested tuples TYPE; see exception_support.md

POP_EXCEPT.note: pop dmem exc-info node; restore active_exc_*; pop TOS prev

RERAISE.note: re-raise TOS through table walk; oparg 0/1 landed; oparg 2 is Track 9 (with)

POP_BLOCK.note: compiler-only pseudo-op; never in co_code; try/finally uses exception tables

SETUP_FINALLY.note: compiler-only pseudo-op; never in co_code; try/finally uses exception tables + RERAISE

SETUP_WITH.note: compiler-only pseudo-op; never in co_code; with uses LOAD_SPECIAL + WITH_EXCEPT_START

EXIT_INIT_CHECK.note: object.__init__ None-check; not in the exceptions plan

LOAD_COMMON_CONSTANT.note: assert: oparg 0 is AssertionError; Track 7; see exception_support.md

POP_JUMP_IF_NONE.note: None identity test; no None scalar in PyCore

POP_JUMP_IF_NOT_NONE.note: None identity test; no None scalar in PyCore

JUMP_IF_FALSE.note: 3.14 peek-branch (net 0, does not pop); replaces 3.13 JUMP_IF_FALSE_OR_POP

CALL.note: Seeded int OBK_TYPE (ob_flags INT_TYPE) converts: argc 0 → 0; argc 1 INT/BOOL identity or decimal SHORT_STR; argc>1 / other tags → TYPE. Exception types still construct OBK_EXCEPTION; other types allocate INSTANCE.

CALL_KW.note: CODE_OBJECT binder via co_varnames; OBK_BUILTIN/TYPE kwargs → CALL_FILTER

CALL_FUNCTION_EX.note: LIST/TUPLE *args expand; kwargs dict via shared binder; NULL = no kwargs

DICT_MERGE.note: Empty-dest alias fast path; non-empty uncontaminated dest → excore DICT_MERGE trap; contaminated dest/src → CALL_FILTER

DICT_UPDATE.note: Uncontaminated A.update(B) → excore DICT_UPDATE trap (grow-to-fit, overwrite dups); contaminated → type trap (pycore bulk update gap)

MAP_ADD.note: Single dict[key]=value in pycore (reuses STORE_DICT probe/insert, DICT_GROW trap); OBJECT key contaminates the dict handle

UNPACK_SEQUENCE.note: LIST/TUPLE only; length mismatch → TYPE; 1 CACHE unit

UNPACK_EX.note: LIST/TUPLE only; middle rest allocated as LIST; wrong length → TYPE

CALL_INTRINSIC_1.note: INTRINSIC_LIST_TO_TUPLE (arg 6) only; other intrinsic ids rejected by image tooling

BINARY_SLICE.note: strings only; CHARACTER-indexed bounds that clamp like CPython; negative bounds and LIST/TUPLE subjects → TYPE

GET_ITER.note: native LIST/TUPLE/RANGE/STR/DICT/SET + OBJECT __iter__ protocol; HEAP_ITER kind 4

FOR_ITER.note: native kinds + HEAP_ITER __next__; StopIteration via call_exc + iter_exhaust_type_r

fold_groups.savings: 3-address local ALU op; no operand-stack traffic
